title: Talented music group LAV.ISH drops new track “Take Your Time”
htmlContent:
LAV.ISH is a music group of 4 members from Los Angeles, California, consisting of Carl and Nim as the vocalists and Lucas and Brandon as the producers. These talented individuals united to establish something yet to be seen in the music scene. Which leads to the release of their latest track, "Take your Time."

The 10th track on the stacked list makes up their 3rd album, "Another Good Day." "Take Your Time" by the LAV.ISH is a smooth, melodic flow greased with an unforgettable R&B hip-hop beat. "Take Your Time" is nothing short of amazing on their raw energy banger with a demanding and exhilarating production while also providing all the excitement in the world for the fans to enjoy.
